products.name: AIpure-HC
products.subtitle: High-pressure automated chromatography system with diode array detection
products.summary: AIpure-HC is a fully configured chromatography system built around PEEK plunger pumps, high-pressure valves rated to 20 MPa, four titanium pressure sensors and a 200–800 nm diode array detector. Inline conductivity, temperature-compensated pH and an automated sample pump with an 8-channel sample inlet valve support unattended loading of multiple large-volume samples. The system is run by ChromX Chromatography Workstation software, which complies with FDA 21 CFR Part 11.

Four titanium-alloy pressure sensors imported from the USA (pump S, system, pre-column and post-column), 0–20 MPa range, with high sensitivity and stability
High-pressure 5-position column valve with working pressure up to 20 MPa, supporting bypass, forward and reverse flow modes
High-pressure injection valve rated to 20 MPa, with sample pump loading, feed, waste and sample loading modes
pH valve supporting online, bypass and calibration modes
High-precision pH electrode with a 1–14 range
Conductivity monitoring from 0–999 mS/cm with automatic temperature compensation; titanium alloy and PEEK flow cell
Sample pump and sample inlet valve for automatic loading of multiple large-volume samples
Diode array detector imported from Europe: 200–800 nm range, low noise and flat baseline, with four wavelength bands adjustable simultaneously
PEEK plunger pumps with double cam, double plunger and double pump head design; phase compensation suppresses pump pulsation
Pump self-washing function prevents salt precipitation; working pressure over 20 MPa; ruby and sapphire biocompatible materials
ChromX Chromatography Workstation software: easy to learn and use, and compliant with FDA 21 CFR Part 11
Column information library tracks column history and performance parameters in real time
System control, manual and automatic methods, scouting, method queue, data analysis, report generation, audit trail and user management
Automatic and manual database backup with data recovery
Free lifelong remote software upgrades, including the upcoming DOE function
Real-time control and monitoring of system operation and data, real-time logging, real-time chromatogram recording and historical view
Buffer management with real-time monitoring of buffer usage

products.subtitle: Modular dual-pump chromatography system with dual-wavelength UV detection
products.summary: AIpure-MC is a flexible, intuitive, fast and reliable dual-pump chromatography system with a flow rate range of 0.001–25 mL/min, with 100 mL and 150 mL versions available as options. It comes standard with dual-wavelength UV (190–400 nm), conductivity, temperature and pH monitoring, ultrasonic bubble sensors, three titanium pressure sensors and an open fraction collector. Inlet, column and outlet valves, a sample pump and a sample inlet valve can be added to match each workflow.

products.subtitle: Dual-pump chromatography system with a 4–600 mL/min flow range and four-wavelength DAD

products.name: Lab-TFF
products.subtitle: Laboratory tangential flow filtration system
products.summary: Lab-TFF is a benchtop tangential flow filtration system for filtration areas from 50 cm² to 0.1 m², with a minimum circulation volume of 20 mL and a circulation pump flow rate of 0–350 mL/min. The basic system includes a 1000 mL circulation tank, feed and transfer pumps, weighing module, stirrer, pressure, conductivity and pH monitoring, membrane fixtures and control software. Preset methods cover water flux testing, concentration, dialysis, CIP, evacuation, harvesting and refill.

products.name: ChromX
products.subtitle: Chromatography workstation software
products.summary: ChromX is a chromatography workstation software for controlling, programming and analysing chromatography runs. It combines real-time system control with a live flow-path diagram, a phase-based method editor with method scouting and design of experiments (DOE), fraction collector control and peak analysis. User, role and department management with function permissions controls who can do what.
features: Real-time system control with live curves for flow, ConcB and system pressure, and an interactive flow-path diagram of inlets, pumps, air sensors, mixer, injection valve, column valve, DAD, conductivity, temperature, pH, outlet and collector
Pre-column, post-column, system and sample-pump pressure readouts with configurable high-alarm limits
Running logs, alarm information, method information and manual information panels
Phase-based method editor with a library of Equilibrium, Injection, Column Wash, Elution, Regeneration/CIP and Pause phases, plus predefined, global and personal phases
Graphical gradient profile preview of the whole method, with configuration conflicts flagged during editing
Sample loop (sample circle), pump and sample-pump injection modes, with constant injection or injection based on an air sensor
Method scouting to set up multiple runs that vary column volume, flow rate, ConcB, pressure limits, valve positions and detector wavelengths
Design of experiments (DOE) with Full Factorial, Fractional Factorial, L9, L18, L27, L36 and Plackett Burman designs

Data analysis reporting peak height, peak area, area %, retention time, half peak width, number of plates, plates per metre, HETP, symmetry factor and smearing factor, with manual analysis and curve comparison
Fraction collector control with two trays, tray and tube commands and an option to pause when tubes overflow
Manual run control for flow rate, gradient, equal flow, column packing flow, system and sample pump injection and wash, with executable, importable and exportable command lists
User, role and department management with user levels, file access levels, file passwords and function permissions
Additional modules for log data, sensor status, parameters, calibration, buffer management, column handling, database and system lock

products.name: 25 mL Piston Pump
products.subtitle: Double-piston pump with PEEK heads, 0.001–25 mL/min up to 34 MPa
products.summary: The 25 mL Piston Pump is a double-cam, double-piston pump with an all-PEEK pump head, a sapphire plunger and Swiss ruby ball valves on sapphire seats, delivering 0.001–25 mL/min at working pressures of 0–34 MPa.
